newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest wheat prices rise in technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Budapest wheat prices rise in technical correction.

text.p: Hungary's milling wheat futures rose in slow trading on Tuesday on what traders described as a technical correction following a declining trend.
"Wheat prices fell substantially recently," said Robert Vajo of Termin Broker Kft. "Now those who are sitting on short positions are buying to take profits."
Traders added that neither world market prices nor the weather justified the price increases, but the correction may continue in the next few days at a reduced pace.
Milling wheat prices rose by 190 to 350 forints per tonne for all futures maturing this year.
July milling wheat added 190 forints to 22,700, while December ended at 24,350, up 200.
The Budapest Stock Exchange's grains futures turnover rose to 247.1 million forints, or 396 lots, from 229.9 million forints on Monday.
